subject: Slot commitment review: runtime capacity and comp-band alignment
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Slot commitment review: runtime capacity and comp-band alignment

Team —

Following the Q3 capacity review, the runtime squad is requesting a commitment for two hires to be onboarded in Q4 so we can support the upcoming edge-serving pilot and kernel stabilization work. High level:

- Role A: Senior Runtime Engineer (Open role, target comp band L5) — strong backend + GPU infra background.
- Role B: Platform Engineer (Open role, target comp band L4) — infra automation and CI/CD focus.

I've attached a short proposal (HC-Proposal-Q4.xlsx) with costed headcount and comp-band options. Key asks: can we get an approval to commit these slots by EOD Wednesday so recruiting can extend offers and hit our onboarding window?

Constraints to call out:
- We need 1 L5 slot (Role A) fully committed; missing that delays the pilot by ~8 weeks.
- There is room to trade an L4 elsewhere in infra if we need to keep budget neutral.

Immediate ask: Kimberly/Marcus — approval to commit headcount and the proposed comp bands, or guidance on which slot to trade down (if necessary).

Thanks,

Avery Johnson
Staff Manager, Runtime
Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
(attachment: HC-Proposal-Q4.xlsx)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slot commitment review: runtime capacity and comp-band alignment

Avery —

Thanks for the write-up and spreadsheet. Quick notes after a skim:

1) Budget: The headcount pool for infra/platform in Q4 is tight. I can approve 1 slot fully (L4), but an L5 will need to be cost-neutral or come from a reprioritized tranche. If you believe the L5 is mission-critical, lay out which non-essential L4 we can defer.

2) Comp bands: please attach the comp-bands-summary.pdf (I couldn't open the XLS on my phone). I want to ensure the L5 offer is within the top 60th percentile for retention — if not, we should consider a signing bonus instead of pushing the base.

3) Timeline: EOD Wednesday is tight for approvals + legal templates + compensation calibration, but doable if recruiting has candidate signoff.

Action for you: Send a one-pager that lists 1) the business impact of missing the L5, 2) candidate-level constraints for offer (target base, equity range, counteroffer risk), and 3) what we can deprioritize if we need to stay budget neutral.

-Kim

Kimberly Park
Dir. People & Ops, Redwood Inference
(attachment requested: comp-bands-summary.pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Slot commitment review: runtime capacity and comp-band alignment

Kim/Avery —

Short technical color to help the decision: the L5 candidate (we've got an in-flight finalist) owns the vectorization/attention-kernel work and has prior experience shipping low-latency batching for mixed precision. Losing them means delaying the pilot and adds ~0.6 FTE of senior offload (we'd need two mid-level hires to cover). The platform L4 role is important but lower risk — we can temporarily shift some CI work to the SRE squad for 6–8 weeks.

Recommendation: Approve the L5 and fund it via a 1-quarter reallocation: pause one planned L4 hire in the analytics infra slate and convert that slot to an L5 for runtime. That keeps net HC flat but aligns seniority to impact.

I'll mark up the HC spreadsheet with the suggested trade and return an updated sheet by 5pm.

Marcus Lin
VP, Runtime & Infrastructure

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, emily.bates@talentpartners.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Slot commitment review: runtime capacity and comp-band alignment

Thanks Marcus — attached is the updated HC-Proposal-Q4.xlsx (tab "trade-proposal") that reflects Marcus's suggested trade (pause Analytics L4 -> convert to Runtime L5). I've also attached comp-bands-summary.pdf to show target ranges.

Summary of changes:
- Convert Analytics L4 slot (planned) into Runtime L5 for Q4 onboarding window.
- Offer targets for the L5 finalist: base $210k, RSU target 0.4% (range 0.35–0.5), signing bonus considered up to $15k if needed.
- Platform L4 remains requested but can be moved to Q1 if budget gating is enforced.

Next steps:
1) Kim: confirm cost-neutral trade approval (convert/repurpose tranche).
2) If approved, recruiting (Emily) will extend an offer using the HelloSign template linked below.
3) Soojin — can you pick up coordination with Finance for one-quarter reallocation and notify analytics leadership?

Avery/Marcus —

After reviewing the updated sheet and speaking with Finance, I approve the one-quarter reallocation: convert the Analytics L4 tranche into the Runtime L5 for Q4. Conditions:

- Recruiting to keep the L5 offer within the provided comp band; use signing bonus only if counteroffer risk is high.
- Soojin/Finance to rebase budgets in the HR system and flag the analytics leadership (they should be notified of the pause and expected slate timeline).
- Legal to use the HelloSign offer template linked in related_links; loop me in for any exceptions.

Avery — you have headcount commitment. Recruit and extend the offer; update me when the candidate accepts so I can approve onboarding start date.

-Kim
